name: GritRoster
tagline: The operations backbone for commercial and industrial cleaning crews.
positioning: GritRoster gives owner-operators one system to dispatch crews, prove work, and bill jobs — built for facilities, warehouses, and post-construction sites.

hero.h1: Run every cleaning contract like clockwork.
hero.sub: GritRoster is the operations platform for industrial cleaning companies. Schedule crews, capture before-and-after proof, track SDS compliance, and invoice the same day the floor dries.

features.title: Crew dispatch that actually holds up
features.description: Assign teams to warehouses, retail floors, and post-construction sites with drag-and-drop shifts. Crews get routes, checklists, and site access notes on the app.

features.title: Proof-of-work in every job
features.description: Techs snap timestamped before-and-after photos tied to each line item. Attach them to invoices so facility managers stop disputing your bill.

features.title: SDS and compliance on file
features.description: Store safety data sheets, chemical logs, and insurance certs per site. Auto-flag expiring documents before an audit or a lost contract does.

features.title: Same-day invoicing
features.description: Turn a completed job card into an invoice in two taps. Sync to QuickBooks and get paid before the crew reaches the next site.

features.title: Recurring contract engine
features.description: Set nightly, weekly, or monthly scopes once. GritRoster generates the schedule, the crew assignments, and the billing on repeat.

features.title: Live job board for the office
features.description: See which sites are in progress, running late, or waiting on a callback — without texting five crew leads at 6 a.m.

testimonials.quote: We were running an eleven-crew operation off a whiteboard and group texts. GritRoster gave us dispatch, proof photos, and invoicing in one place. Disputed invoices dropped by two-thirds in a quarter.
testimonials.name: Marcus Delgado

testimonials.quote: The SDS and insurance tracking alone won us a distribution center contract. We pulled up every chemical log and cert on the spot during their vetting call.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

testimonials.quote: Same-day invoicing changed our cash flow. Crews close the job card, I approve it, the invoice ships. We stopped chasing net-60 accounts through the whole month.
testimonials.name: Danielle Okafor
